# ============================================================
# FASTER CHANGE-POINT SIR MODEL
# Simulation + estimation + parallel bootstrap + simulation study
# ============================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(parallel)

set.seed(123)

# ============================================================
# 1. USER SETTINGS
# ============================================================

# ----------------------------
# FAST DEVELOPMENT SETTINGS
# ----------------------------
times <- seq(0, 60, by = 2)         # fewer time points for speed
tau_candidates <- seq(10, 50, by = 2)  # coarser tau grid
nsim <- 10                          # small for testing
B_boot <- 20                        # small for testing
n_cores <- max(1, detectCores() - 1)

# For final run
times <- 0:60
tau_candidates <- 8:52
nsim <- 50
B_boot <- 50

# ----------------------------
# TRUE PARAMETERS
# ----------------------------
N_true     <- 1000
I0_true    <- 10
R0_true    <- 0
S0_true    <- N_true - I0_true - R0_true

beta1_true <- 0.45
beta2_true <- 0.18
gamma_true <- 0.12
tau_true   <- 25
sigma_true <- 8

# ============================================================
# 2. CHANGE-POINT SIR MODEL
# ============================================================

sir_cp_ode <- function(time, state, parameters) {
  S <- state[1]
  I <- state[2]
  R <- state[3]
  
  beta1 <- parameters["beta1"]
  beta2 <- parameters["beta2"]
  gamma <- parameters["gamma"]
  tau   <- parameters["tau"]
  N     <- parameters["N"]
  
  beta_t <- ifelse(time <= tau, beta1, beta2)
  
  dS <- -beta_t * S * I / N
  dI <-  beta_t * S * I / N - gamma * I
  dR <-  gamma * I
  
  list(c(dS, dI, dR))
}

solve_sir_cp <- function(times, S0, I0, R0, beta1, beta2, gamma, tau, N) {
  state <- c(S = S0, I = I0, R = R0)
  pars  <- c(beta1 = beta1, beta2 = beta2, gamma = gamma, tau = tau, N = N)
  
  out <- ode(
    y = state,
    times = times,
    func = sir_cp_ode,
    parms = pars,
    method = "lsoda"
  )
  
  as.data.frame(out)
}

# ============================================================
# 3. DATA GENERATION
# ============================================================

simulate_cp_sir_data <- function(times, S0, I0, R0, beta1, beta2, gamma, tau, N, sigma) {
  
  sol <- solve_sir_cp(
    times = times,
    S0 = S0,
    I0 = I0,
    R0 = R0,
    beta1 = beta1,
    beta2 = beta2,
    gamma = gamma,
    tau = tau,
    N = N
  )
  
  y_obs <- sol$I + rnorm(length(times), mean = 0, sd = sigma)
  y_obs <- pmax(y_obs, 0)
  
  data.frame(
    time = times,
    I_true = sol$I,
    I_obs = y_obs
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 4. NEGATIVE LOG-LIKELIHOOD
# ============================================================

nll_fixed_tau <- function(par_log, tau, times, y, S0, I0, R0, N) {
  
  beta1 <- exp(par_log[1])
  beta2 <- exp(par_log[2])
  gamma <- exp(par_log[3])
  sigma <- exp(par_log[4])
  
  sol <- try(
    solve_sir_cp(
      times = times,
      S0 = S0,
      I0 = I0,
      R0 = R0,
      beta1 = beta1,
      beta2 = beta2,
      gamma = gamma,
      tau = tau,
      N = N
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(sol, "try-error")) return(1e12)
  
  mu <- sol$I
  
  nll <- -sum(dnorm(y, mean = mu, sd = sigma, log = TRUE))
  
  if (!is.finite(nll)) nll <- 1e12
  return(nll)
}

# ============================================================
# 5. FIT CHANGE-POINT SIR MODEL
#    Speed improvements:
#    - coarser tau grid
#    - warm starts
#    - lower maxit
# ============================================================

fit_cp_sir_fast <- function(times, y, S0, I0, R0, N,
                            tau_candidates = seq(10, 50, by = 2),
                            init = c(beta1 = 0.25, beta2 = 0.15, gamma = 0.10, sigma = 8),
                            maxit = 80) {
  
  results <- data.frame(
    tau = tau_candidates,
    nll = NA_real_,
    beta1 = NA_real_,
    beta2 = NA_real_,
    gamma = NA_real_,
    sigma = NA_real_
  )
  
  current_init <- init
  
  for (k in seq_along(tau_candidates)) {
    tau_k <- tau_candidates[k]
    
    opt <- try(
      optim(
        par = log(current_init),
        fn  = nll_fixed_tau,
        tau = tau_k,
        times = times,
        y = y,
        S0 = S0,
        I0 = I0,
        R0 = R0,
        N = N,
        method = "L-BFGS-B",
        lower = log(c(1e-4, 1e-4, 1e-4, 1e-3)),
        upper = log(c(5, 5, 5, 100)),
        control = list(maxit = maxit)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(opt, "try-error")) {
      est <- exp(opt$par)
      
      results$nll[k]   <- opt$value
      results$beta1[k] <- est[1]
      results$beta2[k] <- est[2]
      results$gamma[k] <- est[3]
      results$sigma[k] <- est[4]
      
      # warm start for next tau
      current_init <- est
    }
  }
  
  valid <- which(is.finite(results$nll))
  if (length(valid) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  best_idx <- which.min(results$nll)
  best_row <- results[best_idx, ]
  
  fitted_sol <- solve_sir_cp(
    times = times,
    S0 = S0,
    I0 = I0,
    R0 = R0,
    beta1 = best_row$beta1,
    beta2 = best_row$beta2,
    gamma = best_row$gamma,
    tau = best_row$tau,
    N = N
  )
  
  list(
    estimates = best_row,
    grid_results = results,
    fitted_solution = fitted_sol
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 6. BOOTSTRAP CI
#    Parallelized bootstrap
# ============================================================

boot_ci <- function(x, level = 0.95) {
  alpha <- 1 - level
  quantile(x, probs = c(alpha / 2, 1 - alpha / 2), na.rm = TRUE)
}

bootstrap_cp_sir_parallel <- function(B, fit_obj, times, S0, I0, R0, N,
                                      tau_candidates = seq(10, 50, by = 2),
                                      n_cores = 2) {
  
  est <- fit_obj$estimates
  
  beta1_hat <- est$beta1
  beta2_hat <- est$beta2
  gamma_hat <- est$gamma
  tau_hat   <- est$tau
  sigma_hat <- est$sigma
  
  fitted_sol <- solve_sir_cp(
    times = times,
    S0 = S0,
    I0 = I0,
    R0 = R0,
    beta1 = beta1_hat,
    beta2 = beta2_hat,
    gamma = gamma_hat,
    tau = tau_hat,
    N = N
  )
  
  mu_hat <- fitted_sol$I
  
  cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
  on.exit(stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
  
  clusterExport(
    cl,
    varlist = c(
      "fit_cp_sir_fast", "solve_sir_cp", "sir_cp_ode", "nll_fixed_tau",
      "times", "S0", "I0", "R0", "N", "tau_candidates",
      "beta1_hat", "beta2_hat", "gamma_hat", "sigma_hat", "mu_hat"
    ),
    envir = environment()
  )
  
  clusterEvalQ(cl, {
    library(deSolve)
    NULL
  })
  
  boot_list <- parLapply(cl, 1:B, function(b) {
    y_boot <- mu_hat + rnorm(length(mu_hat), mean = 0, sd = sigma_hat)
    y_boot <- pmax(y_boot, 0)
    
    fit_b <- try(
      fit_cp_sir_fast(
        times = times,
        y = y_boot,
        S0 = S0,
        I0 = I0,
        R0 = R0,
        N = N,
        tau_candidates = tau_candidates,
        init = c(beta1_hat, beta2_hat, gamma_hat, sigma_hat),
        maxit = 60
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit_b, "try-error") && !is.null(fit_b)) {
      c(
        fit_b$estimates$beta1,
        fit_b$estimates$beta2,
        fit_b$estimates$gamma,
        fit_b$estimates$tau,
        fit_b$estimates$sigma
      )
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, 5)
    }
  })
  
  boot_est <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, boot_list))
  colnames(boot_est) <- c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "tau", "sigma")
  boot_est
}

# ============================================================
# 7. ONE SIMULATION RUN
# ============================================================

run_one_simulation_fast <- function(sim_id,
                                    times,
                                    S0, I0, R0, N,
                                    beta1_true, beta2_true, gamma_true, tau_true, sigma_true,
                                    tau_candidates,
                                    B_boot = 20,
                                    n_cores = 2) {
  
  dat <- simulate_cp_sir_data(
    times = times,
    S0 = S0,
    I0 = I0,
    R0 = R0,
    beta1 = beta1_true,
    beta2 = beta2_true,
    gamma = gamma_true,
    tau = tau_true,
    N = N,
    sigma = sigma_true
  )
  
  fit <- try(
    fit_cp_sir_fast(
      times = times,
      y = dat$I_obs,
      S0 = S0,
      I0 = I0,
      R0 = R0,
      N = N,
      tau_candidates = tau_candidates,
      init = c(0.25, 0.15, 0.10, 8),
      maxit = 80
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error") || is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  est <- fit$estimates
  
  boot_res <- try(
    bootstrap_cp_sir_parallel(
      B = B_boot,
      fit_obj = fit,
      times = times,
      S0 = S0,
      I0 = I0,
      R0 = R0,
      N = N,
      tau_candidates = tau_candidates,
      n_cores = n_cores
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(boot_res, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  
  ci_beta1 <- boot_ci(boot_res$beta1)
  ci_beta2 <- boot_ci(boot_res$beta2)
  ci_gamma <- boot_ci(boot_res$gamma)
  ci_tau   <- boot_ci(boot_res$tau)
  ci_sigma <- boot_ci(boot_res$sigma)
  
  data.frame(
    sim = sim_id,
    
    beta1_true = beta1_true,
    beta2_true = beta2_true,
    gamma_true = gamma_true,
    tau_true   = tau_true,
    sigma_true = sigma_true,
    
    beta1_hat = est$beta1,
    beta2_hat = est$beta2,
    gamma_hat = est$gamma,
    tau_hat   = est$tau,
    sigma_hat = est$sigma,
    
    beta1_lwr = ci_beta1[1],
    beta1_upr = ci_beta1[2],
    beta2_lwr = ci_beta2[1],
    beta2_upr = ci_beta2[2],
    gamma_lwr = ci_gamma[1],
    gamma_upr = ci_gamma[2],
    tau_lwr   = ci_tau[1],
    tau_upr   = ci_tau[2],
    sigma_lwr = ci_sigma[1],
    sigma_upr = ci_sigma[2]
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 8. REPEATED SIMULATION STUDY
# ============================================================

run_simulation_study_fast <- function(nsim = 10,
                                      B_boot = 20,
                                      times = seq(0, 60, by = 2),
                                      N = 1000,
                                      I0 = 10,
                                      R0 = 0,
                                      beta1_true = 0.45,
                                      beta2_true = 0.18,
                                      gamma_true = 0.12,
                                      tau_true = 25,
                                      sigma_true = 8,
                                      tau_candidates = seq(10, 50, by = 2),
                                      n_cores = 2) {
  
  S0 <- N - I0 - R0
  all_res <- vector("list", nsim)
  
  for (s in 1:nsim) {
    cat("Simulation", s, "of", nsim, "\n")
    
    one_res <- run_one_simulation_fast(
      sim_id = s,
      times = times,
      S0 = S0,
      I0 = I0,
      R0 = R0,
      N = N,
      beta1_true = beta1_true,
      beta2_true = beta2_true,
      gamma_true = gamma_true,
      tau_true = tau_true,
      sigma_true = sigma_true,
      tau_candidates = tau_candidates,
      B_boot = B_boot,
      n_cores = n_cores
    )
    
    all_res[[s]] <- one_res
  }
  
  do.call(rbind, all_res)
}

# ============================================================
# 9. PERFORMANCE SUMMARY
# ============================================================

performance_summary <- function(results) {
  
  results <- na.omit(results)
  
  data.frame(
    Parameter = c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "tau", "sigma"),
    
    True = c(
      unique(results$beta1_true),
      unique(results$beta2_true),
      unique(results$gamma_true),
      unique(results$tau_true),
      unique(results$sigma_true)
    ),
    
    Mean_Estimate = c(
      mean(results$beta1_hat),
      mean(results$beta2_hat),
      mean(results$gamma_hat),
      mean(results$tau_hat),
      mean(results$sigma_hat)
    ),
    
    Bias = c(
      mean(results$beta1_hat - results$beta1_true),
      mean(results$beta2_hat - results$beta2_true),
      mean(results$gamma_hat - results$gamma_true),
      mean(results$tau_hat   - results$tau_true),
      mean(results$sigma_hat - results$sigma_true)
    ),
    
    RMSE = c(
      sqrt(mean((results$beta1_hat - results$beta1_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((results$beta2_hat - results$beta2_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((results$gamma_hat - results$gamma_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((results$tau_hat   - results$tau_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((results$sigma_hat - results$sigma_true)^2))
    ),
    
    Coverage_95 = c(
      mean(results$beta1_lwr <= results$beta1_true & results$beta1_true <= results$beta1_upr),
      mean(results$beta2_lwr <= results$beta2_true & results$beta2_true <= results$beta2_upr),
      mean(results$gamma_lwr <= results$gamma_true & results$gamma_true <= results$gamma_upr),
      mean(results$tau_lwr   <= results$tau_true   & results$tau_true   <= results$tau_upr),
      mean(results$sigma_lwr <= results$sigma_true & results$sigma_true <= results$sigma_upr)
    ),
    
    Avg_CI_Width = c(
      mean(results$beta1_upr - results$beta1_lwr),
      mean(results$beta2_upr - results$beta2_lwr),
      mean(results$gamma_upr - results$gamma_lwr),
      mean(results$tau_upr   - results$tau_lwr),
      mean(results$sigma_upr - results$sigma_lwr)
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 10. CHANGE-POINT RECOVERY
# ============================================================

tau_recovery_summary <- function(results) {
  data.frame(
    Exact_Match    = mean(results$tau_hat == results$tau_true, na.rm = TRUE),
    Within_1       = mean(abs(results$tau_hat - results$tau_true) <= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Within_2       = mean(abs(results$tau_hat - results$tau_true) <= 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Within_3       = mean(abs(results$tau_hat - results$tau_true) <= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Abs_Error = mean(abs(results$tau_hat - results$tau_true), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

dat_example <- simulate_cp_sir_data(

  beta1 = beta1_true,
  beta2 = beta2_true,
  gamma = gamma_true,
  tau = tau_true,
  N = N_true,
  sigma = sigma_true
)

fit_example <- fit_cp_sir_fast(
  times = times,
  y = dat_example$I_obs,
  S0 = S0_true,
  I0 = I0_true,
  R0 = R0_true,
  N = N_true,
  tau_candidates = tau_candidates
)

print(fit_example$estimates)

# Plot
plot_df <- data.frame(
  time = times,
  observed = dat_example$I_obs,
  true_I = dat_example$I_true,
  fitted_I = fit_example$fitted_solution$I
)

p1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = observed), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = true_I), linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted_I), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = tau_true, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = fit_example$estimates$tau, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(
    title = "Change-point SIR fit",
    subtitle = "Dashed = true trajectory / true tau, dotted = estimated tau",
    y = "Infected"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

print(p1)

# ============================================================
# 12. RUN FAST SIMULATION STUDY
# ============================================================

results <- run_simulation_study_fast(
  nsim = nsim,
  B_boot = B_boot,
  times = times,
  N = N_true,
  I0 = I0_true,
  R0 = R0_true,
  beta1_true = beta1_true,
  beta2_true = beta2_true,
  gamma_true = gamma_true,
  tau_true = tau_true,
  sigma_true = sigma_true,
  tau_candidates = tau_candidates,
  n_cores = n_cores
)

print(results)

summary_table <- performance_summary(results)
print(summary_table)

tau_recovery <- tau_recovery_summary(results)
print(tau_recovery)

# IMPORTANT PLOTS FOR CHANGE-POINT SIR RESULTS
# Assumes these already exist:
# results, fit_example, dat_example, times, tau_true
# ============================================================

library(ggplot2)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 14))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Observed vs fitted infected trajectory
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_df <- data.frame(
  time = times,
  observed = dat_example$I_obs,
  true_I = dat_example$I_true,
  fitted_I = fit_example$fitted_solution$I
)

p_fit <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = observed), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = true_I), linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted_I), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = tau_true, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = fit_example$estimates$tau, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed and fitted infected trajectory",
    subtitle = "Dashed = true trajectory / true change-point, dotted = estimated change-point",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Number infected"
  )

print(p_fit)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Profile negative log-likelihood over tau
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_profile <- ggplot(fit_example$grid_results, aes(x = tau, y = nll)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = tau_true, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = fit_example$estimates$tau, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Profile negative log-likelihood over the change-point",
    subtitle = "Dashed = true change-point, dotted = estimated change-point",
    x = expression(tau),
    y = "Negative log-likelihood"
  )

print(p_profile)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Distribution of estimated change-points across simulations
# ------------------------------------------------------------
tau_counts <- as.data.frame(table(results$tau_hat))
colnames(tau_counts) <- c("tau_hat", "freq")
tau_counts$tau_hat <- as.numeric(as.character(tau_counts$tau_hat))

p_tau <- ggplot(tau_counts, aes(x = tau_hat, y = freq)) +
  geom_col(fill = "orchid3") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = unique(results$tau_true)[1], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of estimated change-points",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = true change-point",
    x = expression(hat(tau)),
    y = "Frequency"
  )

print(p_tau)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Boxplot of estimation errors
# ------------------------------------------------------------
err_df <- data.frame(
  beta1 = results$beta1_hat - results$beta1_true,
  beta2 = results$beta2_hat - results$beta2_true,
  gamma = results$gamma_hat - results$gamma_true,
  tau   = results$tau_hat   - results$tau_true,
  sigma = results$sigma_hat - results$sigma_true
)

err_long <- stack(err_df)
colnames(err_long) <- c("error", "parameter")

p_err <- ggplot(err_long, aes(x = parameter, y = error)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimation errors across simulations",
    x = "Parameter",
    y = "Estimate - True value"
  )

print(p_err)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Empirical 95% CI coverage
# ------------------------------------------------------------
coverage_df <- data.frame(
  parameter = c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "tau", "sigma"),
  coverage = c(
    mean(results$beta1_lwr <= results$beta1_true & results$beta1_true <= results$beta1_upr, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(results$beta2_lwr <= results$beta2_true & results$beta2_true <= results$beta2_upr, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(results$gamma_lwr <= results$gamma_true & results$gamma_true <= results$gamma_upr, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(results$tau_lwr   <= results$tau_true   & results$tau_true   <= results$tau_upr, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(results$sigma_lwr <= results$sigma_true & results$sigma_true <= results$sigma_upr, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

p_cov <- ggplot(coverage_df, aes(x = parameter, y = coverage)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Empirical 95% bootstrap CI coverage",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = nominal 95% level",
    x = "Parameter",
    y = "Coverage probability"
  )

print(p_cov)
